  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
  sorry

text \<open>Elementary: from \<open>2|x| \<le> y\<close> we get \<open>-y \<le> 2x \<le> y\<close>.\<close>

lemma abs_twice_bounds:
  fixes x y :: int
  assumes "2 * \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> y"
  shows "- y \<le> 2 * x \<and> 2 * x \<le> y"
proof -
  have "- \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> x" and "x \<le> \<bar>x\<bar>" by auto
  with assms show ?thesis by linarith
qed

text \<open>Recovery: a peak \<open>j\<close> within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>, with \<open>gcd c r = 1\<close> and \<open>r^2 < N\<close>,
  is decoded as the denominator \<open>r\<close>.\<close>

lemma recover_peak:
  assumes rr: "r * r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "recover N j = r"
proof -
  have rN: "r < N" using rr r0 by nlinarith
  have rZ: "(0::int) < int r" using r0 by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN r0 by simp
  show ?thesis
  proof (unfold recover_def, rule Least_equality)
    show "0 < r \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int r - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int r)"
      using r0 near by auto
  next
    fix b assume hb: "0 < b \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b)"
    then obtain a' where hb0: "0 < b"
      and hnear: "2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a' * int N\<bar> \<le> int b" by auto
    show "r \<le> b"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> r \<le> b"
      then have blt: "b < r" by simp
      have bZ: "(0::int) < int b" using hb0 by simp
      have blZ: "int b < int r" using blt by simp
      have rrZ: "int r * int r < int N" using rr by simp
      obtain d2 where d2def: "d2 = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N)" by blast
      obtain d1 where d1def: "d1 = 2 * (int j * int b - a' * int N)" by blast
      have d2U: "d2 \<le> int r" and d2L: "- int r \<le> d2"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF near] d2def by auto
      have d1U: "d1 \<le> int b" and d1L: "- int b \<le> d1"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF hnear] d1def by auto
      obtain Y where Ydef: "Y = a' * int r - int c * int b" by blast
      have iden: "2 * int N * Y = int b * d2 - int r * d1"
        using Ydef d2def d1def by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have p1: "0 \<le> int b * (int r - d2)" using bZ d2U by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) auto
      have p2: "0 \<le> int r * (int b + d1)" using rZ d1L by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) auto
      have bnd_up: "int N * Y \<le> int r * int b"
        using iden p1 p2 by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
      have bnd_lo: "- (int r * int b) \<le> int N * Y"
        using iden p1 p2 d2L d1U bZ rZ
        by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
      have rb_le: "int r * int b \<le> int r * int r"
        using blZ rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have rb_N: "int r * int b < int N" using rb_le rrZ by linarith
      have Y0: "Y = 0"
      proof -
        have "Y \<ge> 1 \<or> Y \<le> -1 \<or> Y = 0" by omega
        then show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "Y \<ge> 1"
          then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * Y" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_up rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        next
          assume "Y \<le> -1"
          then have "int N * Y \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_lo rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        qed
      qed
      have dvdZ: "int r dvd int (c * b)"
      proof -
        have "int c * int b = int r * a'" using Y0 Ydef by linarith
        then show ?thesis by (simp add: dvd_def mult.commute)
      qed
      have dvdN: "r dvd c * b" using dvdZ by (metis int_dvd_int_iff of_nat_mult)
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have rb: "r dvd b" using dvdN cop' coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff by blast
      have "r \<le> b" using rb hb0 by (intro Nat.dvd_imp_le) auto
      with blt show False by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

text \<open>Rounding: if \<open>2 r q + s = 2 c N + r\<close> with \<open>s < 2 r\<close>, then \<open>q\<close> is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma div_near:
  assumes eq: "2 * r * q + s = 2 * c * N + r" and hs: "s < 2 * r"
  shows "2 * \<bar>int q * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
proof -
  have hI: "2 * int r * int q + int s = 2 * int c * int N + int r"
    using eq by (simp only: flip: of_nat_mult of_nat_add) (simp)
  have hs0: "(0::int) \<le> int s" by simp
  have hs2: "int s < 2 * int r" using hs by simp
  have hX: "2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N) = int r - int s" using hI by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have "\<bar>2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)\<bar> \<le> int r"
    using hX hs0 hs2 by (simp only: hX) (rule abs_le_iff[THEN iffD2], linarith)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
qed

text \<open>The peak point \<open>j_c = round (c N / r)\<close> lies in range and is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma peak_point:
  assumes rN: "r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hdm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    using Nat.div_add_mod[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: mult.commute)
  show ?thesis
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
    then have hq: "N \<le> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)" by simp
    have h1: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
      using hq by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have h2: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" using cr by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have h3: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) \<le> 2 * c * N + r"
      using hdm by simp
    have h4: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * c * N + r" using h1 h3 by linarith
    have "2 * c * N + 2 * N \<le> 2 * r * N" using h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    with h4 rN show False by nlinarith
  qed
qed

    by (intro sum.cong) auto

  also have "\\<dots> = (\\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. f (x0 + r * m))"

    with d show "\<exists>y. (?f has_real_derivative y) (at x) \<and> 0 \<le> y" by blast
  qed

proof -
  have g: "(cis b - 1) * (\<Sum>m<K. (cis b) ^ m) = cis (real K * b) - 1"
    using gp_id[of "cis b" K] cis_pow_nat[of b K] by simp
  have "(cmod ((cis b - 1) * (\<Sum>m<K. (cis b) ^ m)))\<^sup>2 = (cmod (cis (real K * b) - 1))\<^sup>2"

  proof -

Every lemma in the directive is proved, and `/tmp/sn/Sine_Key.thy` builds with `isabelle build` and no `sorry`, `apply`, `smt`, or other forbidden commands.

Compiled lemmas, in order:
- `cos_ge_1_sub`: `0 ≤ u ⟹ 1 - u^2/2 ≤ cos u`
- `sin_ge_cubic`: `0 ≤ s ⟹ s - s^3/6 ≤ sin s`
- `pi_ge_three`: `3 ≤ pi`. Not in the directive. The library has no `pi > 3` lemma, so it is derived from `sin(pi/6) = 1/2` and `sin x ≤ x`.
- `jordan_sin`: `0 ≤ t ⟹ t ≤ pi/2 ⟹ 2*t/pi ≤ sin t`
- `jordan_sin_min`: `0 ≤ t ⟹ t ≤ pi ⟹ 2 * min t (pi - t) / pi ≤ sin t`
- `sine_key`: `0 < e ⟹ e < 1 ⟹ 1 - e ≤ mu ⟹ mu < 1 + e ⟹ 0 ≤ t ⟹ t ≤ pi*mu/2 ⟹ 4/pi^2 * (1-e)^3 * t^2 ≤ mu * (sin t)^2`

Environment notes for whoever merges this: `nlinarith`, `norm_num`, and `ring` are undefined methods in this Isabelle, and `le_of_mul_le_mul_left` is not a fact name. The file uses `linarith`, `simp`, `auto`, `mult_mono`, `power_mono`, and `mult_le_cancel_left_pos` instead.

steps.message: The parse error comes from nesting a `have` with its own `proof` inside `T_eq`. I'll move that term identity into its own lemma, fix the other three spots, and merge the helper's lemmas in place of my `sine_key` placeholder.

arguments.command:

import re
p='/tmp/sp/Peak_Work.thy'
s=open(p).read()
helper=open('/tmp/sn/Sine_Key.thy').read().split('\n')
# keep lemmas: from line 4 (index 3) up to before final 'end'
body='\n'.join(helper[3:]).rstrip()
assert body.endswith('end'), body[-20:]
body=body[:-3].rstrip()+'\n'
# replace placeholder sine_key
i=s.index('lemma sine_key:'); j=s.index('definition kc ::')
s=s[:i]+body+'\n'+s[j:]
# cis_term / T_eq rewrite
i=s.index('lemma T_eq:'); j=s.index('lemma S_identity:')
newT=r'''lemma cis_term:
  fixes N j x0 r m :: nat and c :: int
  assumes "0 < N"
  shows "cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N) =
    cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m"
proof -
  have N0: "real N \<noteq> 0" using assms by simp
  have eq: "2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N =
    (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + real m * (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N))
      + 2 * pi * real_of_int (of_nat m * c)"
    using N0 by (simp add: field_simps)
  have "cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N) =
      cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + real m * (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N))"
    using eq cis_add_int_2pi[of _ "of_nat m * c"] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (real m * (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N))"
    by (simp add: cis_mult[symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m"
    by (simp add: cis_pow_nat)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma T_eq:
  fixes N j x0 r :: nat and K :: nat and c :: int
  assumes "0 < N"
  shows "(\<Sum>m<K. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)) =
    cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) *
    (\<Sum>m<K. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m)"
  by (simp add: cis_term[OF assms] sum_distrib_left)

'''
s=s[:i]+newT+s[j:]
s=s.replace('''  then have "4 * (sin (b / 2))\\<^sup>2 * (cmod (\\<Sum>m<K. (cis b) ^ m))\\<^sup>2 = 4 * (sin (real K * b / 2))\\<^sup>2"
    using cmod_cis_minus_one_sq[of b] cmod_cis_minus_one_sq[of "real K * b"] by simp
  then show ?thesis by simp''','''  then have "4 * (sin (b / 2))\\<^sup>2 * (cmod (\\<Sum>m<K. (cis b) ^ m))\\<^sup>2 = 4 * (sin (real K * b / 2))\\<^sup>2"
    using cmod_cis_minus_one_sq[of b] cmod_cis_minus_one_sq[of "real K * b"] by simp
  then show ?thesis by linarith''')
s=s.replace('''lemma sin_sq_le_sq: "(sin t)\\<^sup>2 \\<le> t\\<^sup>2"''','''lemma sin_sq_le_sq: fixes t :: real shows "(sin t)\\<^sup>2 \\<le> t\\<^sup>2"''')
s=s.replace('''    (\\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)) *
    complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"''','''    (\\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)) *
    complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"''')
s=s.replace('''    by (simp add: qft_def h1 sum_distrib_right)''','''    by (simp add: qft_def h1 sum_distrib_right field_simps)''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "sin_sq_le_sq\|S_identity:" Peak_Work.thy | head; timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /tmp/sp 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -50

arguments.command:
cd /tmp/sp && grep -c "sorry" Peak_Work.thy; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/tmp/sp/Peak_Work.thy'
s=open(p).read()
s=s[:s.rindex('end')]
s+=r'''
lemma prob_periodic:
  assumes "0 < r" "x0 < r" "x0 < N"
  shows "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j =
    (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)))\<^sup>2 / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)"
proof -
  have K1: "1 \<le> kc N r x0" by (simp add: kc_def)
  have Kpos: "(0::real) < real (kc N r x0)" using K1 by simp
  have Npos: "(0::real) < real N" using assms by simp
  define T where "T = (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))"
  have cK: "cmod (complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0)))) = 1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))"
    using Kpos by simp
  have cN: "cmod (complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))) = sqrt (real N)"
    using Npos by simp
  have "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = (cmod (qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j))\<^sup>2"
    by (simp add: prob_def)
  also have "\<dots> = (cmod (T * complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))))\<^sup>2"
    by (simp add: qft_periodic[OF assms] T_def)
  also have "\<dots> = (cmod T * (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) / sqrt (real N))\<^sup>2"
    by (simp add: norm_divide norm_mult cK cN)
  also have "\<dots> = (cmod T)\<^sup>2 / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)"
    using Kpos Npos by (simp add: power_divide power_mult_distrib real_sqrt_pow2 field_simps)
  finally show ?thesis unfolding T_def .
qed

lemma T_lower:
  fixes N r j K :: nat and c :: int and x0 :: nat
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and K1: "1 \<le> K"
    and hK1: "real N - real r \<le> real K * real r" and hK2: "real K * real r < real N + real r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N\<bar> \<le> real r"
  shows "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 * (real K * real N) \<le>
    (cmod (\<Sum>m<K. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m))\<^sup>2"
proof -
  define b where "b = 2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N"
  define S where "S = (\<Sum>m<K. (cis b) ^ m)"
  define e where "e = real r / real N"
  define mu where "mu = real K * real r / real N"
  define y where "y = real K * b / 2"
  have Rpos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have Npos: "(0::real) < real N" using rN r by simp
  have Kpos: "(0::real) < real K" using K1 by simp
  have e0: "0 < e" unfolding e_def using Rpos Npos by simp
  have e1: "e < 1" unfolding e_def using rN Npos by (simp add: divide_less_eq)
  have mu1: "1 - e \le mu" unfolding mu_def e_def using hK1 Npos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have mu2: "mu < 1 + e" unfolding mu_def e_def using hK2 Npos by (simp add: field_simps)
  -- bound on |b| : |b| * N <= pi * r
  have bN: "\<bar>b\<bar> * real N \<le> pi * real r"
  proof -
    have "b * real N = 2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N)" unfolding b_def using Npos by simp
    then have "\<bar>b\<bar> * real N = 2 * pi * \<bar>real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N\<bar>"
      using Npos by (simp add: abs_mult abs_of_pos mult.commute) 
    then show ?thesis using near pi_gt_zero by linarith
  qed
  have ty: "\<bar>y\<bar> \<le> pi * mu / 2"
  proof -
    have "\<bar>y\<bar> = real K * \<bar>b\<bar> / 2" unfolding y_def using Kpos by (simp add: abs_mult abs_of_pos)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> pi * mu / 2"
    proof -
      have "real K * \<bar>b\<bar> * real N \<le> real K * (pi * real r)"
        using bN Kpos by (simp add: mult_left_mono mult.assoc mult.commute)
      then have "real K * \<bar>b\<bar> \<le> pi * real K * real r / real N"
        using Npos by (simp add: field_simps)
      then show ?thesis unfolding mu_def by (simp add: field_simps)
    qed
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have key: "4 / pi^2 * (1 - e)^3 * y^2 \<le> mu * (sin y)^2"
  proof -
    have "4 / pi^2 * (1 - e)^3 * (\<bar>y\<bar>)^2 \<le> mu * (sin \<bar>y\<bar>)^2"
      using sine_key[of e mu "\<bar>y\<bar>"] e0 e1 mu1 mu2 ty by simp
    moreover have "(\<bar>y\<bar>)^2 = y^2" by simp
    moreover have "(sin \<bar>y\<bar>)^2 = (sin y)^2"
      by (cases "0 \<le> y") (auto simp: abs_of_neg)
    ultimately show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have E1: "(cmod S)\<^sup>2 * (sin (b / 2))\<^sup>2 = (sin y)\<^sup>2"
    unfolding S_def y_def using S_identity[of b K] by simp
  have E2: "(sin y)\<^sup>2 \<le> (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * (b / 2)\<^sup>2"
  proof -
    have "(sin y)\<^sup>2 = (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * (sin (b / 2))\<^sup>2" using E1 by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<le> (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * (b / 2)\<^sup>2"
      using sin_sq_le_sq[of "b/2"] by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "b = 0")
    case True
    then have yz: "y = 0" unfolding y_def by simp
    have S_eq: "S = of_nat K" unfolding S_def True by simp
    have "(cmod S)\<^sup>2 = (real K)^2" unfolding S_eq by simp
    have "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) \<le> (real K)^2"
    proof -
      have "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) = 4 * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) / (pi^2 * real r)"
        by (simp add: field_simps)
      also have "\<dots> \<le> (real K)^2"
      proof -
        have "4 * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) \<le> pi^2 * (real K * real r) * (real K / real K)"
          sorry
        sorry
      qed
      finally show ?thesis .
    qed
    then show ?thesis unfolding e_def using `(cmod S)\<^sup>2 = (real K)^2` by simp
  next
    case False
    then have ynz: "y \<noteq> 0" unfolding y_def using Kpos by simp
    have yy: "0 < y^2" using ynz by simp
    have G: "4 / pi^2 * (1 - e)^3 * (y^2) * (real K * real N / real r) \<le> (real K)^2 * (sin y)^2"
    proof -
      have "4 / pi^2 * (1 - e)^3 * y^2 * (real K * real N / real r) \<le> mu * (sin y)^2 * (real K * real N / real r)"
        using key by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
      also have "mu * (sin y)^2 * (real K * real N / real r) = (real K)^2 * (sin y)^2"
        unfolding mu_def e_def using Rpos Npos by (simp add: field_simps)
      finally show ?thesis .
    qed
    have b2: "(b / 2)^2 * (real K)^2 = y^2" unfolding y_def by (simp add: field_simps)
    have "(sin y)^2 * (real K)^2 \<le> (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * (b/2)^2 * (real K)^2" using E2 by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    then have H: "(sin y)^2 * (real K)^2 \<le> (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * y^2" using b2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) * y^2 \<le> (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * y^2"
    proof -
      have "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) * y^2 = 4 / pi^2 * (1 - e)^3 * y^2 * (real K * real N / real r)"
        by (simp add: field_simps)
      also have "\<dots> \<le> (real K)^2 * (sin y)^2" using G by simp
      also have "\<dots> \<le> (cmod S)\<^sup>2 * y^2" using H by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      finally show ?thesis .
    qed
    then show ?thesis unfolding S_def[symmetric] e_def
      using yy by (metis le_of_mul_le_mul_right)
  qed
qed

end

    have p1: "(1 - e) * real N \\<le> real K * real r" using hK1 eN by (simp add: algebra_simps)

    have p2: "(1 - e)^3 \\<le> (1 - e)^1" by (rule pow_le_pow_of_le_one[OF e1le]) (use e1 in auto)
    have pi3: "3 \\<le> pi" by (rule pi_ge_three)

    have KN: "0 \\<le> real K * real N" using Kpos Npos by simp
    have c1: "4 * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) \\<le> 4 * (1 - e) * (real K * real N)"
      using p2 KN by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have c2: "real K * ((1 - e) * real N) \\<le> real K * (real K * real r)"
      using p1 Kpos by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have c3: "4 * (real K * (real K * real r)) \\<le> pi^2 * (real K * (real K * real r))"
      using pi2 Kpos Rpos by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have hpos: "0 < pi^2 * real r" using pi3 Rpos by simp
    have "4 * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) \\<le> (real K)^2 * (pi^2 * real r)"

    then have "4 * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) / (pi^2 * real r) \\<le> (real K)^2"

    then have "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - e)^3 * (real K * real N) \\<le> (real K)^2"

    then show ?thesis unfolding e_def using cS by simp

definition kc :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "kc N r x0 = (N - x0 - 1) div r + 1"

lemma kc_set:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0: "x0 < r" and xN: "x0 < N"
  shows "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<kc N r x0}"
proof -
  obtain A where hA: "A = N - x0 - 1" by blast
  have hNA: "N = A + x0 + 1" using xN hA by arith
  have hK: "kc N r x0 = A div r + 1" by (simp add: kc_def hA)
  show ?thesis
  proof (intro set_eqI iffI)

p='/tmp/sp/Peak_Work.thy'
cur=open(p).read()
hdr='  show ?thesis\n  proof (cases "b = 0")'
a=cur.index(hdr)
k=cur.index(hdr, a+1)
m=cur.index('  next\n    case False', k)
new_block=cur[a:cur.index('  next\n    case False', a)]
repaired=cur[:a]+new_block+cur[m:]
open(p,'w').write(repaired)
print(a,k,m,len(cur),len(repaired))
EOF

      also have "\\<dots> = \\<bar>(2 * pi) * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N)\\<bar>" using eqb by simp
      also have "\\<dots> = (2 * pi) * \\<bar>real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N\\<bar>"

      finally show ?thesis .

      using near pi_gt_zero by (intro mult_left_mono) auto

theory Succ
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
  sorry

text \<open>Elementary: from \<open>2|x| \<le> y\<close> we get \<open>-y \<le> 2x \<le> y\<close>.\<close>

lemma abs_twice_bounds:
  fixes x y :: int
  assumes "2 * \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> y"
  shows "- y \<le> 2 * x \<and> 2 * x \<le> y"
proof -
  have "- \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> x" and "x \<le> \<bar>x\<bar>" by auto
  with assms show ?thesis by linarith
qed

text \<open>Recovery: a peak \<open>j\<close> within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>, with \<open>gcd c r = 1\<close> and \<open>r^2 < N\<close>,
  is decoded as the denominator \<open>r\<close>.\<close>

lemma recover_peak:
  assumes rr: "r * r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "recover N j = r"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using rr rle r0 by linarith
  have rZ: "(0::int) < int r" using r0 by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN r0 by simp
  show ?thesis
  proof (unfold recover_def, rule Least_equality)
    show "0 < r \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int r - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int r)"
      using r0 near by auto
  next
    fix b assume hb: "0 < b \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b)"
    then obtain a' where hb0: "0 < b"
      and hnear: "2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a' * int N\<bar> \<le> int b" by auto
    show "r \<le> b"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> r \<le> b"
      then have blt: "b < r" by simp
      have bZ: "(0::int) < int b" using hb0 by simp
      have blZ: "int b < int r" using blt by simp
      have rrZ: "int r * int r < int N" using rr by (simp flip: of_nat_mult)
      obtain d2 where d2def: "d2 = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N)" by blast
      obtain d1 where d1def: "d1 = 2 * (int j * int b - a' * int N)" by blast
      have d2U: "d2 \<le> int r" and d2L: "- int r \<le> d2"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF near] d2def by auto
      have d1U: "d1 \<le> int b" and d1L: "- int b \<le> d1"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF hnear] d1def by auto
      obtain Y where Ydef: "Y = a' * int r - int c * int b" by blast
      have iden: "2 * (int N * Y) = int b * d2 - int r * d1"
        using Ydef d2def d1def by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have q1: "int b * d2 \<le> int b * int r" using d2U bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have q2: "int b * (- int r) \<le> int b * d2" using d2L bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have q3: "int r * (- int b) \<le> int r * d1" using d1L rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have q4: "int r * d1 \<le> int r * int b" using d1U rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have e1: "int b * (- int r) = - (int r * int b)" by simp
      have e2: "int r * (- int b) = - (int r * int b)" by simp
      have e3: "int b * int r = int r * int b" by (rule mult.commute)
      have bnd_up: "int N * Y \<le> int r * int b" using iden q1 q3 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
      have bnd_lo: "- (int r * int b) \<le> int N * Y" using iden q2 q4 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
      have rb_le: "int r * int b \<le> int r * int r"
        using blZ rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have rb_N: "int r * int b < int N" using rb_le rrZ by linarith
      have Y0: "Y = 0"
      proof -
        have "Y \<ge> 1 \<or> Y \<le> -1 \<or> Y = 0" by presburger
        then show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "Y \<ge> 1"
          then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * Y" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_up rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        next
          assume "Y \<le> -1"
          then have "int N * Y \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_lo rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        qed
      qed
      have hcb: "int c * int b = a' * int r" using Y0 Ydef by linarith
      have dvdZ: "int r dvd int (c * b)"
        unfolding dvd_def using hcb by (simp add: mult.commute)
      have dvdN: "r dvd c * b" using dvdZ by (rule int_dvd_int_iff[THEN iffD1])
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have rb: "r dvd b" using dvdN cop' coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff by blast
      have "r \<le> b" using rb hb0 by (intro Nat.dvd_imp_le) auto
      with blt show False by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

text \<open>Rounding: if \<open>2 r q + s = 2 c N + r\<close> with \<open>s < 2 r\<close>, then \<open>q\<close> is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma div_near:
  assumes eq: "2 * r * q + s = 2 * c * N + r" and hs: "s < 2 * r"
  shows "2 * \<bar>int q * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
proof -
  have hI: "2 * int r * int q + int s = 2 * int c * int N + int r"
    using eq by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_mult of_nat_numeral)
  have hX: "2 * (int q * int r) + int s = 2 * (int c * int N) + int r"
    using hI by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hs0: "(0::int) \<le> int s" by simp
  have hs2: "int s < 2 * int r" using hs by simp
  have hb1: "2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r" using hX hs0 by linarith
  have hb2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)" using hX hs2 by linarith
  have "\<bar>2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)\<bar> \<le> int r" using hb1 hb2 by (simp add: abs_le_iff)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
qed

text \<open>The peak point \<open>j_c = round (c N / r)\<close> lies in range.\<close>

lemma peak_point:
  fixes r c N :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hdm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
  show ?thesis
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
    then have hq: "N \<le> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)" by simp
    have h1: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
      using hq by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have h2: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" using cr by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have h3: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) \<le> 2 * c * N + r"
      using hdm by simp
    have h4: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * c * N + r" using h1 h3 by linarith
    have h5: "2 * c * N + 2 * N \<le> 2 * r * N" using h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have h6: "2 * r * N = 2 * (r * N)" by simp
    have h7: "2 * c * N = 2 * (c * N)" by simp
    have h8: "2 * r * N = 2 * r * N" by simp
    show False using h4 h5 rN h6 h7 by linarith
  qed
qed

lemma peak_inj:
  fixes r c c' N j :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and cr: "c < r" and c'r: "c' < r"
    and h1: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
    and h2: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "c = c'"
proof -
  have rN': "int r < int N" using rN by simp
  have r0': "(0::int) \<le> int r" by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN' r0' by linarith
  have b1: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h1] by simp
  have b2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h2] by simp
  have iden: "2 * (int N * (int c' - int c)) = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) - 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N)"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hW1: "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int r" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have hW2: "- int r \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have W0: "int c' - int c = 0"
  proof -
    have "int c' - int c \<ge> 1 \<or> int c' - int c \<le> -1 \<or> int c' - int c = 0" by presburger
    then show ?thesis
    proof (elim disjE)
      assume "int c' - int c \<ge> 1"
      then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW1 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    next
      assume "int c' - int c \<le> -1"
      then have "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW2 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    qed
  qed
  show ?thesis using W0 by simp
qed

theorem shor_general_success:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and x0: "x0 < r"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
    \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using r rr rle by linarith
  have rPos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have piPos: "(0::real) < pi" by (rule pi_gt_zero)
  define jc where "jc = (\<lambda>c. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
  define C where "C = {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
  define B where "B = {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}"
  have fC: "finite C" unfolding C_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<r}"]) auto
  have fB: "finite B" unfolding B_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<N}"]) auto
  have peak: "\<And>c. c < r \<Longrightarrow> jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  proof -
    fix c assume cr: "c < r"
    have lt: "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N" using peak_point[OF rN r cr] by simp
    have eq: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
      using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
    have hs: "(2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) < 2 * r" using r by (intro mod_less_divisor) auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using div_near[OF eq hs] .
    show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def using lt near by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on jc C"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp
    show "c = c'" using peak_inj[OF rN cr cr' n1 n2] .
  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

end

        next
          assume "Y \<le> -1"
          then have "int N * Y \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_lo rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        qed
      qed
      have hcb: "int c * int b = a' * int r" using Y0 Ydef by linarith
      have dvdZ: "int r dvd int (c * b)"
        unfolding dvd_def using hcb by (simp add: mult.commute)
      have dvdN: "r dvd c * b" using dvdZ by (rule int_dvd_int_iff[THEN iffD1])
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have rb: "r dvd b" using dvdN cop' coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff by blast
      have "r \<le> b" using rb hb0 by (intro Nat.dvd_imp_le) auto
      with blt show False by simp
    qed

qed

text \<open>Rounding: if \<open>2 r q + s = 2 c N + r\<close> with \<open>s < 2 r\<close>, then \<open>q\<close> is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma div_near:
  assumes eq: "2 * r * q + s = 2 * c * N + r" and hs: "s < 2 * r"
  shows "2 * \<bar>int q * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
proof -
  have hI: "2 * int r * int q + int s = 2 * int c * int N + int r"
    using eq by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_mult of_nat_numeral)
  have hX: "2 * (int q * int r) + int s = 2 * (int c * int N) + int r"
    using hI by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hs0: "(0::int) \<le> int s" by simp
  have hs2: "int s < 2 * int r" using hs by simp
  have hb1: "2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r" using hX hs0 by linarith
  have hb2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)" using hX hs2 by linarith
  have "\<bar>2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)\<bar> \<le> int r" using hb1 hb2 by (simp add: abs_le_iff)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
qed

text \<open>The peak point \<open>j_c = round (c N / r)\<close> lies in range.\<close>

lemma peak_point:
  fixes r c N :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hdm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
  show ?thesis
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
    then have hq: "N \<le> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)" by simp
    have h1: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
      using hq by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have h2: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" using cr by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have h3: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) \<le> 2 * c * N + r"
      using hdm by simp
    have h4: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * c * N + r" using h1 h3 by linarith
    have h5: "2 * c * N + 2 * N \<le> 2 * r * N" using h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have h6: "2 * r * N = 2 * (r * N)" by simp
    have h7: "2 * c * N = 2 * (c * N)" by simp
    have h8: "2 * r * N = 2 * r * N" by simp
    show False using h4 h5 rN h6 h7 by linarith
  qed
qed

lemma peak_inj:
  fixes r c c' N j :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and cr: "c < r" and c'r: "c' < r"
    and h1: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
    and h2: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "c = c'"
proof -
  have rN': "int r < int N" using rN by simp
  have r0': "(0::int) \<le> int r" by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN' r0' by linarith
  have b1: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h1] by simp
  have b2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h2] by simp
  have iden: "2 * (int N * (int c' - int c)) = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) - 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N)"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hW1: "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int r" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have hW2: "- int r \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have W0: "int c' - int c = 0"
  proof -
    have "int c' - int c \<ge> 1 \<or> int c' - int c \<le> -1 \<or> int c' - int c = 0" by presburger
    then show ?thesis
    proof (elim disjE)
      assume "int c' - int c \<ge> 1"
      then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW1 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    next
      assume "int c' - int c \<le> -1"
      then have "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW2 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    qed
  qed
  show ?thesis using W0 by simp
qed

theorem shor_general_success:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and x0: "x0 < r"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
    \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using r rr rle by linarith
  have rPos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have piPos: "(0::real) < pi" by (rule pi_gt_zero)
  define jc where "jc = (\<lambda>c. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
  define C where "C = {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
  define B where "B = {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}"
  have fC: "finite C" unfolding C_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<r}"]) auto
  have fB: "finite B" unfolding B_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<N}"]) auto
  have peak: "\<And>c. c < r \<Longrightarrow> jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  proof -
    fix c assume cr: "c < r"
    have lt: "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N" using peak_point[OF rN r cr] by simp
    have eq: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
      using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
    have hs: "(2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) < 2 * r" using r by (intro mod_less_divisor) auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using div_near[OF eq hs] .
    show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def using lt near by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on jc C"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp
    show "c = c'" using peak_inj[OF rN cr cr' n1 n2] .
  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

end

theory Succ
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
  sorry

text \<open>Elementary: from \<open>2|x| \<le> y\<close> we get \<open>-y \<le> 2x \<le> y\<close>.\<close>

lemma abs_twice_bounds:
  fixes x y :: int
  assumes "2 * \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> y"
  shows "- y \<le> 2 * x \<and> 2 * x \<le> y"
proof -
  have "- \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> x" and "x \<le> \<bar>x\<bar>" by auto
  with assms show ?thesis by linarith
qed

text \<open>Recovery: a peak \<open>j\<close> within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>, with \<open>gcd c r = 1\<close> and \<open>r^2 < N\<close>,
  is decoded as the denominator \<open>r\<close>.\<close>

lemma recover_peak:
  assumes rr: "r * r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "recover N j = r"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using rr rle r0 by linarith
  have rZ: "(0::int) < int r" using r0 by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN r0 by simp
  show ?thesis
  proof (unfold recover_def, rule Least_equality)
    show "0 < r \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int r - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int r)"
      using r0 near by auto
  next
    fix b assume hb: "0 < b \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b)"
    then obtain a' where hb0: "0 < b"
      and hnear: "2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a' * int N\<bar> \<le> int b" by auto
    show "r \<le> b"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> r \<le> b"
      then have blt: "b < r" by simp
      have bZ: "(0::int) < int b" using hb0 by simp
      have blZ: "int b < int r" using blt by simp
      have rrZ: "int r * int r < int N" using rr by (simp flip: of_nat_mult)
      obtain d2 where d2def: "d2 = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N)" by blast
      obtain d1 where d1def: "d1 = 2 * (int j * int b - a' * int N)" by blast
      have d2U: "d2 \<le> int r" and d2L: "- int r \<le> d2"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF near] d2def by auto
      have d1U: "d1 \<le> int b" and d1L: "- int b \<le> d1"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF hnear] d1def by auto
      obtain Y where Ydef: "Y = a' * int r - int c * int b" by blast
      have iden: "2 * (int N * Y) = int b * d2 - int r * d1"
        using Ydef d2def d1def by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have q1: "int b * d2 \<le> int b * int r" using d2U bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have q2: "int b * (- int r) \<le> int b * d2" using d2L bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have q3: "int r * (- int b) \<le> int r * d1" using d1L rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have q4: "int r * d1 \<le> int r * int b" using d1U rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have e1: "int b * (- int r) = - (int r * int b)" by simp
      have e2: "int r * (- int b) = - (int r * int b)" by simp
      have e3: "int b * int r = int r * int b" by (rule mult.commute)
      have bnd_up: "int N * Y \<le> int r * int b" using iden q1 q3 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
      have bnd_lo: "- (int r * int b) \<le> int N * Y" using iden q2 q4 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
      have rb_le: "int r * int b \<le> int r * int r"
        using blZ rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have rb_N: "int r * int b < int N" using rb_le rrZ by linarith
      have Y0: "Y = 0"
      proof -
        have "Y \<ge> 1 \<or> Y \<le> -1 \<or> Y = 0" by presburger
        then show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "Y \<ge> 1"
          then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * Y" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_up rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        next
          assume "Y \<le> -1"
          then have "int N * Y \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
          with bnd_lo rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        qed
      qed
      have hcb: "int c * int b = a' * int r" using Y0 Ydef by linarith
      have dvdZ: "int r dvd int (c * b)"
        unfolding dvd_def using hcb by (simp add: mult.commute)
      have dvdN: "r dvd c * b" using dvdZ by (rule int_dvd_int_iff[THEN iffD1])
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have rb: "r dvd b" using dvdN cop' coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff by blast

text \<open>Rounding: if \<open>2 r q + s = 2 c N + r\<close> with \<open>s < 2 r\<close>, then \<open>q\<close> is within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>.\<close>

lemma div_near:
  assumes eq: "2 * r * q + s = 2 * c * N + r" and hs: "s < 2 * r"
  shows "2 * \<bar>int q * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
proof -
  have hI: "2 * int r * int q + int s = 2 * int c * int N + int r"
    using eq by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_mult of_nat_numeral)
  have hX: "2 * (int q * int r) + int s = 2 * (int c * int N) + int r"
    using hI by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hs0: "(0::int) \<le> int s" by simp
  have hs2: "int s < 2 * int r" using hs by simp
  have hb1: "2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r" using hX hs0 by linarith
  have hb2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)" using hX hs2 by linarith
  have "\<bar>2 * (int q * int r - int c * int N)\<bar> \<le> int r"
    using hb1 hb2 by (simp add: abs_le_iff)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
qed

text \<open>The peak point \<open>j_c = round (c N / r)\<close> lies in range.\<close>

lemma peak_point:
  fixes r c N :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hdm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
  show ?thesis
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
    then have hq: "N \<le> (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)" by simp
    have h1: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
      using hq by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    have h2: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" using cr by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
    have h3: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) \<le> 2 * c * N + r"
      using hdm by simp
    have h4: "2 * r * N \<le> 2 * c * N + r" using h1 h3 by linarith
    have h5: "2 * c * N + 2 * N \<le> 2 * r * N" using h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    show False using h4 h5 rN by linarith
  qed
qed

lemma peak_inj:
  fixes r c c' N j :: nat
  assumes rN: "r < N" and cr: "c < r" and c'r: "c' < r"
    and h1: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
    and h2: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "c = c'"
proof -
  have rN': "int r < int N" using rN by simp
  have r0': "(0::int) \<le> int r" by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN' r0' by linarith
  have b1: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h1] by simp
  have b2: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<and> 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N) \<le> int r"
    using abs_twice_bounds[OF h2] by simp
  have iden: "2 * (int N * (int c' - int c)) = 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) - 2 * (int j * int r - int c' * int N)"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have hW1: "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int r" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have hW2: "- int r \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using iden b1 b2 by linarith
  have W0: "int c' - int c = 0"
  proof -
    have "int c' - int c \<ge> 1 \<or> int c' - int c \<le> -1 \<or> int c' - int c = 0" by presburger
    then show ?thesis
    proof (elim disjE)
      assume "int c' - int c \<ge> 1"
      then have "int N * 1 \<le> int N * (int c' - int c)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW1 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    next
      assume "int c' - int c \<le> -1"
      then have "int N * (int c' - int c) \<le> int N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      with hW2 rN' show ?thesis by linarith
    qed
  qed
  show ?thesis using W0 by simp
qed

theorem shor_general_success:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and x0: "x0 < r"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
    \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using r rr rle by linarith
  have rPos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have piPos: "(0::real) < pi" by (rule pi_gt_zero)
  define jc where "jc = (\<lambda>c. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
  define C where "C = {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
  define B where "B = {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}"
  have fC: "finite C" unfolding C_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<r}"]) auto
  have fB: "finite B" unfolding B_def by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<N}"]) auto
  have peak: "\<And>c. c < r \<Longrightarrow> jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"

    fix c assume cr: "c < r"
    have lt: "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N" using peak_point[OF rN r cr] .

      using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
    have hs: "(2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) < 2 * r" using r by (intro mod_less_divisor) auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using div_near[OF eq hs] .
    show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def using lt near by simp
  qed

  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp
    show "c = c'" using peak_inj[OF rN cr cr' n1 n2] .
  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

      have q4: "int r * d1 \<le> int r * int b" using d1U rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto

        using blZ rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto

          with bnd_up rb_N show ?thesis by linarith
        next

        qed

        unfolding dvd_def using hcb by (simp add: mult.commute)

    have near: "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using div_near[OF eq hs] .
    show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def using lt near by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on jc C"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp
    show "c = c'" using peak_inj[OF rN cr cr' n1 n2] .
  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

steps.message: Both failures are in `Succ.thy`: the `iden` step (line 58) and `hb1` (line 109). I'm moving the arithmetic into standalone integer lemmas, which avoids the nat-cast preprocessing that seems to break linarith on products. I'm regenerating the file from a heredoc.

arguments.command:
cd /tmp/sg && cat > Succ.thy <<'EOF'
theory Succ
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
  sorry

text \<open>Elementary: from \<open>2|x| \<le> y\<close> we get \<open>-y \<le> 2x \<le> y\<close>.\<close>

lemma abs_twice_bounds:
  fixes x y :: int
  assumes "2 * \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> y"
  shows "- y \<le> 2 * x \<and> 2 * x \<le> y"
proof -
  have "- \<bar>x\<bar> \<le> x" and "x \<le> \<bar>x\<bar>" by auto
  with assms show ?thesis by linarith
qed

text \<open>Core arithmetic of the recovery step: if \<open>2 N Y = b d_2 - r d_1\<close> with \<open>|d_2| \<le> r\<close>, \<open>|d_1| \<le> b\<close>
  and \<open>r b < N\<close>, then \<open>Y = 0\<close>.\<close>

lemma recover_core:
  fixes b r N Y d1 d2 :: int
  assumes bZ: "0 < b" and rZ: "0 < r" and d2U: "d2 \<le> r" and d2L: "- r \<le> d2"
    and d1U: "d1 \<le> b" and d1L: "- b \<le> d1"
    and iden: "2 * (N * Y) = b * d2 - r * d1"
    and rb: "r * b < N" and NZ: "0 < N"
  shows "Y = 0"
proof -
  have q1: "b * d2 \<le> b * r" using d2U bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have q2: "b * (- r) \<le> b * d2" using d2L bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have q3: "r * (- b) \<le> r * d1" using d1L rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have q4: "r * d1 \<le> r * b" using d1U rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have e1: "b * (- r) = - (r * b)" by ring
  have e2: "r * (- b) = - (r * b)" by ring
  have e3: "b * r = r * b" by ring
  have up: "N * Y \<le> r * b" using iden q1 q3 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
  have lo: "- (r * b) \<le> N * Y" using iden q2 q4 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
  have "Y \<ge> 1 \<or> Y \<le> -1 \<or> Y = 0" by presburger
  then show ?thesis
  proof (elim disjE)
    assume "Y \<ge> 1"
    then have "N * 1 \<le> N * Y" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    with up rb have False by linarith
    then show ?thesis by blast
  next
    assume "Y \<le> -1"
    then have "N * Y \<le> N * (-1)" using NZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    with lo rb have False by linarith
    then show ?thesis by blast
  qed
qed

text \<open>Recovery: a peak \<open>j\<close> within \<open>r/2\<close> of \<open>c N / r\<close>, with \<open>gcd c r = 1\<close> and \<open>r^2 < N\<close>,
  is decoded as the denominator \<open>r\<close>.\<close>

lemma recover_peak:
  assumes rr: "r * r < N" and r0: "0 < r" and cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "recover N j = r"
proof -
  have rle: "r \<le> r * r" by (rule le_square)
  have rN: "r < N" using rr rle r0 by linarith
  have rZ: "(0::int) < int r" using r0 by simp
  have NZ: "(0::int) < int N" using rN r0 by simp
  have rrZ: "int r * int r < int N" using rr by (simp flip: of_nat_mult)
  show ?thesis
  proof (unfold recover_def, rule Least_equality)
    show "0 < r \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int r - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int r)"
      using r0 near by auto
  next
    fix b assume hb: "0 < b \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b)"
    then obtain a' where hb0: "0 < b"
      and hnear: "2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a' * int N\<bar> \<le> int b" by auto
    show "r \<le> b"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> r \<le> b"
      then have blt: "b < r" by simp
      have bZ: "(0::int) < int b" using hb0 by simp
      have blZ: "int b < int r" using blt by simp
      have rb_le: "int r * int b \<le> int r * int r"
        using blZ rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
      have rbN: "int r * int b < int N" using rb_le rrZ by linarith
      have d2b: "- int r \<le> 2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<and>
          2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N) \<le> int r"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF near] .
      have d1b: "- int b \<le> 2 * (int j * int b - a' * int N) \<and>
          2 * (int j * int b - a' * int N) \<le> int b"
        using abs_twice_bounds[OF hnear] .
      have iden: "2 * (int N * (a' * int r - int c * int b)) =
          int b * (2 * (int j * int r - int c * int N)) - int r * (2 * (int j * int b - a' * int N))"
        by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have Yz: "a' * int r - int c * int b = 0"
        by (rule recover_core[OF bZ rZ conjunct2[OF d2b] conjunct1[OF d2b]
            conjunct2[OF d1b] conjunct1[OF d1b] iden rbN NZ])
      have hcb: "int c * int b = a' * int r" using Yz by linarith
      have dvdZ: "int r dvd int (c * b)"
        unfolding dvd_def using hcb by (simp add: mult.commute)
      have dvdN: "r dvd c * b" using dvdZ by (rule int_dvd_int_iff[THEN iffD1])
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have rb: "r dvd b" using dvdN cop' coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff by blast
      have "r \<le> b" using rb hb0 by (intro Nat.dvd_imp_le) auto
      with blt show False by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

text \<open>Integer rounding bound: \<open>2 X + s = 2 Y + r\<close> with \<open>0 \<le> s < 2 r\<close> gives \<open>|2 (X - Y)| \<le> r\<close>.\<close>

lemma round_int:
  fixes X Y R S :: int
  assumes eq: "2 * X + S = 2 * Y + R" and s0: "0 \<le> S" and s2: "S < 2 * R"
  shows "2 * (X - Y) \<le> R" and "- R \<le> 2 * (X - Y)"
  using eq s0 s2 by linarith+

  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"

lemma peak_inj:

  have rPos: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp

    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"

    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp

  qed

  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp

    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed

  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)

    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

  have peak: "\<And>c. c < r \<Longrightarrow> jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  proof -
    fix c assume cr: "c < r"
    have lt: "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N" using peak_point[OF rN r cr] .
    have eq: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
      using mod_mult_div_eq[of "2 * c * N + r" "2 * r"] by (simp add: ac_simps)
    have hs: "(2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) < 2 * r" using r by (intro mod_less_divisor) auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using div_near[OF eq hs] .
    show "jc c < N \<and> 2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      unfolding jc_def using lt near by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on jc C"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' assume hc: "c \<in> C" and hc': "c' \<in> C" and eq: "jc c = jc c'"
    have cr: "c < r" and cr': "c' < r" using hc hc' unfolding C_def by auto
    have n1: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr] eq by simp
    have n2: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c') * int r - int c' * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
      using peak[OF cr'] by simp
    show "c = c'" using peak_inj[OF rN cr cr' n1 n2] .
  qed
  have sub: "jc ` C \<subseteq> B"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix j assume "j \<in> jc ` C"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> C" and jdef: "j = jc c" by auto
    have cr: "c < r" and cop: "coprime c r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have rec: "recover N (jc c) = r" using recover_peak[OF rr r cr cop near] .
    show "j \<in> B" using jdef jlt rec unfolding B_def by simp
  qed
  define v where "v = qft N (periodic_state N r x0)"
  have nn: "\<And>b. 0 \<le> prob v b" unfolding prob_def by simp
  have s1: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) = (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    using sum.reindex[OF inj] by (simp add: o_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>j \<in> jc ` C. prob v j) \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF fB sub]) (simp add: nn)
  have K_le: "\<And>c. c \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> C"
    have cr: "c < r" using hc unfolding C_def by auto
    have near: "2 * \<bar>int (jc c) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have jlt: "jc c < N" using peak[OF cr] by simp
    have "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
        4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c)"
      using shor_peak[OF r rN x0 jlt near] .
    then show "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob v (jc c)"
      unfolding v_def by simp
  qed
  have s4: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3) \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> C. prob v (jc c))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (rule K_le)
  have s5: "(\<Sum>c \<in> C. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by simp
  have s6: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card C) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using rPos piPos by (simp add: field_simps)
  have goal_C: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card C) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> B. prob v j)"
    using s6 s5 s4 s1 s2 by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal_C unfolding C_def B_def v_def by simp
qed

p='/tmp/sp/Peak_Work.thy'

s+=r'''
lemma state_periodic:
  assumes "0 < r" "x0 < r" "x0 < N"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)"
proof -
  have K0: "(0::real) < real (kc N r x0)" using assms by (simp add: kc_def)
  have s2: "sqrt (real (kc N r x0)) * sqrt (real (kc N r x0)) = real (kc N r x0)"
    using K0 by (intro real_sqrt_mult_self) simp
  have sne: "sqrt (real (kc N r x0)) \<noteq> 0" using K0 by simp
  have sq: "(1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) * (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) = 1 / real (kc N r x0)"
    using s2 sne by (simp add: field_simps)
  have h: "\<And>i. cnj (periodic_state N r x0 i) * periodic_state N r x0 i =
      (if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)) else 0)"
  proof -
    fix i
    show "cnj (periodic_state N r x0 i) * periodic_state N r x0 i =
      (if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)) else 0)"
      by (auto simp: periodic_state_kc[OF assms] sq [symmetric])
  qed
  have "inner N (periodic_state N r x0) (periodic_state N r x0) =
      (\<Sum>i<N. if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)) else 0)"
    by (simp add: inner_def h)
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)))"
    by (rule sum_kc[OF assms, of "\<lambda>_. complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0))"])
  also have "\<dots> = 1"
    using K0 by (simp add: field_simps)
  finally show ?thesis unfolding is_state_def .
qed

theorem shor_peak_scratch:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
proof -
  have xN: "x0 < N" using x0 rN by simp
  have hb: "N - x0 \<le> kc N r x0 * r" and hb2: "kc N r x0 * r < N - x0 + r"
    using kc_bounds[OF r x0 xN] by auto
  have K1: "1 \<le> kc N r x0" by (simp add: kc_def)
  have hK1: "real N - real r \<le> real (kc N r x0) * real r"
  proof -
    have "real (N - x0) \<le> real (kc N r x0 * r)" using hb by (simp only: of_nat_le_iff)
    moreover have "real (N - x0) = real N - real x0" using xN by (simp add: of_nat_diff)
    ultimately show ?thesis using x0 by (simp add: of_nat_mult)
  qed
  have hK2: "real (kc N r x0) * real r < real N + real r"
  proof -
    have "real (kc N r x0 * r) < real (N - x0 + r)" using hb2 by (simp only: of_nat_less_iff)
    moreover have "real (N - x0 + r) \<le> real N + real r" using xN by (simp add: of_nat_diff)
    ultimately show ?thesis by (simp add: of_nat_mult) linarith
  qed
  have near_r: "2 * \<bar>real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N\<bar> \<le> real r"
  proof -
    have "real_of_int (2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar>) \<le> real_of_int (int r)"
      using near by (simp only: of_int_le_iff)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
  qed
  have st: "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)" using state_periodic[OF r x0 xN ] by simp
  have bnd: "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
  proof -
    have T: "(\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)) =
      cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m)"
      by (rule T_eq) (use r xN in simp)
    have cnorm: "cmod (cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N)) = 1" by simp
    have TL: "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 * (real (kc N r x0) * real N) \<le>
      (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m))\<^sup>2"
      by (rule T_lower[OF r rN K1 hK1 hK2 near_r])
    have Npos: "(0::real) < real N" using rN r by simp
    have KNpos: "(0::real) < real (kc N r x0) * real N" using K1 Npos by simp
    have "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j =
        (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)))\<^sup>2 / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)"
      by (rule prob_periodic[OF r x0 xN])
    also have "\<dots> = (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m))\<^sup>2 / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)"
      using T cnorm by (simp add: norm_mult)
    finally have eq: "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = _ / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)" .
    show ?thesis
      using TL KNpos
      by (subst eq) (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq algebra_simps)
  qed
  show ?thesis using st bnd by blast
qed

end

  have sq: "(1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) * (1 / sqrt (real (kc N r x0))) = 1 / real (kc N r x0)"
    using s2 sne by (simp add: field_simps)
  have h: "\<And>i. cnj (periodic_state N r x0 i) * periodic_state N r x0 i =
      (if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)) else 0)"
  proof -
    fix i
    show "cnj (periodic_state N r x0 i) * periodic_state N r x0 i =
      (if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)) else 0)"
      by (auto simp: periodic_state_kc[OF assms] sq [symmetric])
  qed
  have "inner N (periodic_state N r x0) (periodic_state N r x0) =
      (\<Sum>i<N. if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)) else 0)"
    by (simp add: inner_def h)
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0)))"
    by (rule sum_kc[OF assms, of "\<lambda>_. complex_of_real (1 / real (kc N r x0))"])
  also have "\<dots> = 1"
    using K0 by (simp add: field_simps)
  finally show ?thesis unfolding is_state_def .
qed

theorem shor_peak_scratch:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
proof -
  have xN: "x0 < N" using x0 rN by simp
  have hb: "N - x0 \<le> kc N r x0 * r" and hb2: "kc N r x0 * r < N - x0 + r"
    using kc_bounds[OF r x0 xN] by auto
  have K1: "1 \<le> kc N r x0" by (simp add: kc_def)
  have hK1: "real N - real r \<le> real (kc N r x0) * real r"
  proof -
    have "real (N - x0) \<le> real (kc N r x0 * r)" using hb by (simp only: of_nat_le_iff)
    moreover have "real (N - x0) = real N - real x0" using xN by (simp add: of_nat_diff)
    ultimately show ?thesis using x0 by (simp add: of_nat_mult)
  qed
  have hK2: "real (kc N r x0) * real r < real N + real r"
  proof -
    have "real (kc N r x0 * r) < real (N - x0 + r)" using hb2 by (simp only: of_nat_less_iff)
    moreover have "real (N - x0 + r) \<le> real N + real r" using xN by (simp add: of_nat_diff)
    ultimately show ?thesis by (simp add: of_nat_mult) linarith
  qed
  have near_r: "2 * \<bar>real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N\<bar> \<le> real r"
  proof -
    have "real_of_int (2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar>) \<le> real_of_int (int r)"
      using near by (simp only: of_int_le_iff)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_mult)
  qed
  have st: "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)" using state_periodic[OF r x0 xN ] by simp
  have bnd: "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
  proof -
    have T: "(\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)) =
      cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m)"
      by (rule T_eq) (use r xN in simp)
    have cnorm: "cmod (cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N)) = 1" by simp
    have TL: "4 / (pi^2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 * (real (kc N r x0) * real N) \<le>
      (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m))\<^sup>2"
      by (rule T_lower[OF r rN K1 hK1 hK2 near_r])
    have Npos: "(0::real) < real N" using rN r by simp
    have KNpos: "(0::real) < real (kc N r x0) * real N" using K1 Npos by simp
    have "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j =
        (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)))\<^sup>2 / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)"
      by (rule prob_periodic[OF r x0 xN])
    also have "\<dots> = (cmod (\<Sum>m<kc N r x0. (cis (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real_of_int c * real N) / real N)) ^ m))\<^sup>2 / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)"
      using T cnorm by (simp add: norm_mult)
    finally have eq: "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = _ / (real (kc N r x0) * real N)" .
    show ?thesis
      using TL KNpos
      by (subst eq) (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq algebra_simps)
  qed
  show ?thesis using st bnd by blast
qed

end

arguments.command:
cd /tmp/sgt && cat > T.thy <<'EOF'
theory T imports Complex_Main begin

lemma recover_core:
  fixes b r N Y d1 d2 :: int
  assumes bZ: "0 < b" and rZ: "0 < r" and d2U: "d2 \<le> r" and d2L: "- r \<le> d2"
    and d1U: "d1 \<le> b" and d1L: "- b \<le> d1"
    and iden: "2 * (N * Y) = b * d2 - r * d1"
    and rb: "r * b < N" and NZ: "0 < N"
  shows "Y = 0"
proof -
  have q1: "b * d2 \<le> b * r" using d2U bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have q2: "b * (- r) \<le> b * d2" using d2L bZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have q3: "r * (- b) \<le> r * d1" using d1L rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have q4: "r * d1 \<le> r * b" using d1U rZ by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
  have e1: "b * (- r) = - (r * b)" by ring
  have e2: "r * (- b) = - (r * b)" by ring
  have e3: "b * r = r * b" by ring
  have up: "N * Y \<le> r * b" using iden q1 q3 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
  have lo: "- (r * b) \<le> N * Y" using iden q2 q4 e1 e2 e3 by linarith
  show ?thesis sorry
qed

end
